product_variants_dimensions_positive.name: product_variants_dimensions_positive
product_variants_dimensions_positive.value: ("product_variants"."length_millimeters" IS NULL OR "product_variants"."length_millimeters" > 0) AND ("product_variants"."width_millimeters" IS NULL OR "product_variants"."width_millimeters" > 0) AND ("product_variants"."height_millimeters" IS NULL OR "product_variants"."height_millimeters" > 0)

outbox_events_processed_state_consistent.name: outbox_events_processed_state_consistent
outbox_events_processed_state_consistent.value: ("outbox_events"."status" = 'processed' AND "outbox_events"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("outbox_events"."status" <> 'processed' AND "outbox_events"."processed_at" IS NULL)

outbox_events_lock_state_consistent.name: outbox_events_lock_state_consistent
outbox_events_lock_state_consistent.value: ("outbox_events"."status" = 'processing' AND "outbox_events"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "outbox_events"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL) OR ("outbox_events"."status" <> 'processing' AND "outbox_events"."locked_at" IS NULL AND "outbox_events"."locked_by" IS NULL)
